name: DARE-bench
intro: DARE-bench 是一个面向数据科学与机器学习建模任务的基准，用于评估大模型在复杂多步数据科学任务中的建模能力与指令忠实度，并提供可验证真值以支持客观评测。
build_method: Kaggle开放数据采集, LLM任务构造, 受控后处理, 可验证真值
metric: IF精确匹配, Macro-F1, 截断R²
modality: 文本, 代码, 表格
task_type: 代码生成, 数据科学建模, 时间序列预测
eval_feature: 可验证真值, 指令遵循, 过程评估
intro_en: DARE-bench is a benchmark for data science and machine learning modeling tasks. It evaluates LLM agents on complex multi-step data science workflows, instruction fidelity, and objectively verifiable outcomes.
build_method_en: Open Kaggle Data Collection, LLM Task Design, Controlled Post-Processing, Verifiable Ground Truth
metric_en: IF Exact Match, Macro-F1, Clipped R²
task_type_en: Code Generation, Data Science Modeling, Time Series Forecasting
eval_feature_en: Verifiable Ground Truth, Instruction Following, Process Evaluation

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:2602.24288v1 and Snowflake-Labs/dare-bench @ 0144714. The paper contract has 6,300 tasks: 5,948 train and 352 evaluation. The pinned license-filtered public release is smaller at 4,274 train and 324 evaluation tasks from 2,137 train and 162 evaluation source datasets. The diagram therefore makes the release boundary explicit. Its variant-specific routes preserve random versus chronological splits, roughly 20% IF training-noise injection with a clean test set, entity leakage checks, optional time-series resampling, IF sandboxed reference code with a fixed seed, and masked original labels for MM/XF/CF. Standard evaluation uses five turns and a 200-second code-execution timeout, then exact match, Macro-F1, or clipped R² according to variant.
